item.title: [ZEPPELIN-5881] can't compile spark 3.3

Hi comet, could you please try to check dependencies of module zeppelin-server by below command:

mvn -pl 'zeppelin-server,zeppelin-zengine,zeppelin-common,zeppelin-interpreter,zeppelin-jupyter' dependency:tree

Your error message as missing dependency maybe.

i ran this command

 

./mvnw -pl 'zeppelin-server,zeppelin-zengine,zeppelin-common,zeppelin-interpreter,zeppelin-jupyter' dependency:tree

 

output at: https://paste.ofcode.org/T6ruSMnYDE69uzzaBLMacS , no errors

 

 

I suggest, if you want to see the error , in zepplin folder, master branch, run below command after changed the dockerfile  ``` {}Pspark{-}3.3 ```

docker build -t zeppelin-distribution:latest .

 
-Pspark-3.3

Hi comet, I could reproduced your issue when building docker image by command:

docker build -t zeppelin-distribution:latest .

Note: no need to change Maven Profile from -Pspark-3.2 to -Pspark-3.3
good to know you can reproduce it. only happen for master branch. for other tag v0.10.1 , has no issue

Hi comet, I checked and found that issue come from maven profile hadoop3.
You can change -Phadoop3 to -Phadoop2 and built successfully.
I tried:

./mvnw package -DskipTests -Pbuild-distr -Pinclude-hadoop -Phadoop2 -Pspark-3.3 -Pspark-scala-2.12 -Pweb-angular -Pweb-dist

And got result: https://paste.ofcode.org/FPhNLxKpu9wj9Dh3LpjFu5

Thank you phongnt , can we get the hadoop3 working because the default spark 3.3 is using hadoop3. if you downlod spark 3.3 from apache website, inside the jars folder, they are using 3.3.2 for hadoop

 

in fact, i tested with 
./mvnw package -DskipTests -Pspark-3.3
working as well if not including any hadoop, but after that cannot build zepplin-server and interpreter docker images
